correctness.rationale: Differentiate bond phases y_j=θ_{j+1}−θ_j to obtain dot y_j=F(y_{j+1})−F(y_{j−1}), conserving y1+y3=a. Torus coordinates u,v yield dot u=A(a)sin v, dot v=B(a)sin u and H=B cos u−A cos v. Solving B=0 and A=0 gives exactly two leaves a_±; independently differentiated AB at a_- and verified |(AB)'|=4cd, nonzero shear κ=4cd/sqrt(c²+d²). On a shear leaf the moving angle rotates with speed κ sin(frozen angle), primitive P=2π/(κ|sin w|), whose exact Haar distribution gives inverse-time tail and divergent mean. Otherwise H is Morse with 2 centers and 2 saddles; by coarea E[P] reduces to integral P(E)² dE, locally finite because saddle period diverges logarithmically. Center period 2π/sqrt(|AB|) therefore tends to π/sqrt(cd)|a−a±|⁻½. Assumption is conditional Haar on leaf and reduced modulo overall phase; no full-space claim.
